name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For safety, ptr must still own its potential weak reference; pointers created by Weak::new own no weak reference and are nevertheless permitted.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::sync::Weak < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
expression: Not expressible in the supplied DSL: it has no observation for weak-reference ownership or the Weak::new exception.
